title: 自體免疫疾病的 CAR-T、MSC 與 Tregs

blocks.en: 93CART Cells and Other Cell Therapies (ie MSC, Tregs) in Autoimmune Diseases Raffaella Greco and Dominique Farge 93.1 Introduction Auto-immune diseases (AD) are heterogeneous conditions, characterized by polyclonal activation of the immune system with a defect of B or T lymphocyte selection and altered lymphocytic reactions to auto-antigens components (Burnet 1959a, b), although it is rare to identify a single antigenic epitope. The native immune system and its tissue environment play an important role to determine if exposure to a given antigen will induce an immune response or tolerance or anergy. The role of the genes coding for the major histocompatibility system molecules, but also of many other genes, is important in the regulation of the immune response, although this does not explain all the observed phenomena during loss of tolerance (Matzinger 1994; Rioux and Abbas 2005).
blocks.zh: 【第93章：自體免疫疾病的 CAR-T 與其他細胞治療（MSC、Tregs）】作者：Raffaella Greco、Dominique Farge。〔93.1 導論〕AD 是異質疾病，以免疫系統多克隆活化、B／T 淋巴球選擇缺陷，以及對自體抗原成分的反應改變為特徵（Burnet，1959a、b），但很少能找出單一抗原表位。先天免疫系統與組織環境，會影響抗原暴露究竟引發免疫反應、耐受或無反應。MHC 分子及許多其他基因，對免疫調節很重要，但無法解釋耐受喪失時的所有現象（Matzinger，1994；Rioux 與 Abbas，2005）。

blocks.en: Over the years, a better understanding of the genetic background of ADs led to revise the traditional pathogenesis of autoimmune diseases.
blocks.zh: 近年對 AD 遺傳背景更深入的了解，使傳統的自體免疫病生理概念受到修正。

blocks.en: The presence of self-directed tissue inflammation as a component of each type of AD occurs independently of T or B cells abnormalities. Most of the classical AD are polygenic diseases which result from a combination of auto-inflammatory and autoimmune mechanisms (Rioux and Abbas 2005; McGonagle and McDermott 2006) with a predominant autoimmune component background [systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), Type 1 diabetes (T1D), autoimmune thyroiditis], whereas other polygenic AD have a predominant auto-inflammatory component [Crohn’s disease (CD) for instance]. More exceptionally, ADs are set by mutations associated with monogenic autoimmune diseases [Immunodysregulation polyendocrinopathy enteropathy X-linked syndrome (IPEX) with FOXP3 mutation] or on the other hand of the spectrum appear as monogenic auto-inflammatory diseases [Familial Mediterranean Fever with MEFV/pyrin, or TNF receptor-associated periodic fever syndrome (TRAPS) with TNFRSFIA/TNFR1].
blocks.zh: 每一類 AD 都可能有對自身組織的發炎，並不完全依賴 T／B 細胞異常。多數典型 AD 是自體發炎與自體免疫機轉共同作用的多基因疾病（Rioux 與 Abbas，2005；McGonagle 與 McDermott，2006）。SLE、第一型糖尿病、自體免疫甲狀腺炎等，以自體免疫成分為主；Crohn disease 等則較偏自體發炎。較少見者是單基因自體免疫疾病，例如 FOXP3 變異造成的 IPEX；光譜另一端則是單基因自體發炎疾病，例如 MEFV／pyrin 相關家族性地中海熱，或 TNFRSF1A／TNFR1 相關 TRAPS。

blocks.en: Autoimmunity is used to cause by impairment of adaptive immunity, whereas autoinflammatory was originally defined as a consequence of unregulated innate immunity. Despite the contrast in the system primarily tangled, they share a lot of similarities, both in pathogenesis and clinical presentations. Therefore, the optimal treatment of an AD should be discussed considering  this specific pathological continuum between autoimmunity and auto-inflammation, which variably interacts in the ultimate phenotypic expression (Alexander and Greco 2022). blocks.zh: 傳統上，自體免疫被歸於適應性免疫失衡，自體發炎則歸於先天免疫失控。雖然最初涉及的系統不同，兩者在病生理及臨床表現上有許多相似處。因此，最佳治療應考慮自體免疫與自體發炎的連續光譜，以及兩者如何共同決定最終表型（Alexander 與 Greco，2022）。作者機構：R. blocks.en: In this context, restoration of the immune tolerance with consequent resolution of the inflammatory response against self-antigens is one of the treatment goals to provide durable remissions.
blocks.zh: 在此背景下，恢復免疫耐受、讓對自體抗原的發炎反應消退，是獲得持久緩解的治療目標之一。

blocks.en: Different types of cellular therapies, which include mesenchymal stem cells (MSC), regulatory T cells (Tregs) and chimeric antigen receptors (CAR) T cell therapies, have been developed to restore immunologic self-tolerance or foster tissue regeneration in AD patients.
blocks.zh: MSC、regulatory T cells（Tregs）與 CAR-T 等不同細胞療法，已被開發用來恢復自我免疫耐受，或促進 AD 患者組織再生。

blocks.en: 93.2 Mesenchymal Stem Cells (MSC) MSC-based therapies (Burt et al. 2021) theoretically appear as ideal tools to target the respective auto-inflammatory and autoimmune components of AD.
blocks.zh: 〔93.2 間質幹／基質細胞（MSC）〕理論上，MSC 療法可同時針對 AD 的自體發炎與自體免疫成分，因而是理想工具（Burt 等，2021）。

blocks.en: MSC were first identified in the bone marrow (MSC- bone marrow [BM])-stem cell niche 45 years ago (Friedenstein 1976) and since extensively characterized as main support of haematopoiesis. These multipotent progenitor cells can be harvested and cultured in vitro from many other sources, mostly from adipose tissue- MSC(AT)-, umbilical cord (MSC- umbilical cord [UC]) or Wharton’s jelly MSC (WJ) for therapeutic applications. In vitro expanded MSC were defined a minima in 2006 by the International Society of Cellular Therapy (ISCT) MSC committee as: (1) a plastic-adherent polyclonal population with fibroblast-like morphology, (2) positive for CD73, CD90 and CD105 markers (in >95% MSC), (3) negative for haematopoietic and endothelial markers and (4) able to differentiate in vitro into osteoblasts, adipocytes and chondroblasts (Dominici et al. 2006). MSC have in vitro and in vivo immune-modulatory and immunosuppressive effects on both the innate and adaptive immunity and also pro-angiogenic and anti-fibrotic properties, all supporting their therapeutic use in several AD.
blocks.zh: MSC 約在 45 年前，首次於骨髓幹細胞 niche 中被辨識（Friedenstein，1976），此後被廣泛研究為造血的主要支持細胞。這些多潛能祖細胞也可從其他組織取得並體外培養，主要包括脂肪、臍帶及 Wharton’s jelly。ISCT MSC 委員會於 2006 年提出體外擴增 MSC 的最低定義：① 黏附塑膠、具纖維母細胞樣形態的多克隆群體；② >95% 表現 CD73、CD90、CD105；③ 不表現造血及內皮標記；④ 體外能分化為成骨、脂肪及軟骨細胞（Dominici 等，2006）。MSC 在體外及體內可調控、抑制先天與適應性免疫，也有促血管新生與抗纖維化特性，支持其 AD 治療潛力。

blocks.en: While MSC from various tissue sources share many biological features, they differ in terms of proliferation potential, multilineage capacities, overall transcriptional profile and functionality.
blocks.zh: 不同組織來源 MSC 雖有許多共同生物特性，增殖潛力、多系分化能力、整體轉錄輪廓與功能仍不同。

blocks.en: Importantly, numerous other parameters modulate MSC functional properties, including autologous or allogeneic donor sources, each step of production processes (culture conditions, priming, scale of expansion, cryopreservation) and the recipients characteristics and inflammatory environment, which account for high heterogeneity amongst the various MSC products used for clinical application (Barrett et al. 2019; Fernandez- Santos et al. 2022; Menard and Tarte 2013).
blocks.zh: 其他影響功能的因素包括自體／異體來源、製造各階段（培養、priming、擴增規模、冷凍），以及受者特徵與發炎環境，造成臨床 MSC 產品高度異質（Barrett 等，2019；Fernandez-Santos 等，2022；Menard 與 Tarte，2013）。

blocks.en: MSC have long been considered as immunoprivileged, due to low level of MHC class I molecules and lack of MHC class II and several co-stimulatory molecules expression at basal state on their cell surface. However, MSC exposure to inflammatory environment increases the MHC class I and induces MHC class II molecules expression. The use of unmatched allogeneic MSC infusion may induce anti-HLA class I anti-bodies, with potential clinical consequences which are still under study (Farge et al. 2021, 2022; Menard and Tarte 2013).
blocks.zh: MSC 在基礎狀態的 MHC-I 表現低，且缺乏 MHC-II 與多種共刺激分子，因此長期被認為具有 immune privilege。但發炎暴露會提高 MHC-I 並誘導 MHC-II；輸注未配對異體 MSC 可能誘發 anti-HLA class I 抗體，臨床後果仍在研究（Farge 等，2021、2022；Menard 與 Tarte，2013）。

blocks.en: MSCs interact with the humoral and the cell-mediated immune responses (Menard and Tarte 2013), including B-, T-, NK, and dendritic-cell inhibition, decrease in pro-inflammatory cytokine production, and blocking neutrophil recruitment ( Fig. 93.1). They may act by cell to cell contact, but their primary mechanism of action is paracrine, through the secretion of enzymes (Han et al. 2022), with a central role for IDO/iNOS, and various growth factors, cytokines, hormones (e.g., VEGF, PDGF, ANG-1, IL-11, PGE2, TSG- 6, SDF-1, HGF, IGF-1), which are not constitutively expressed by the MSCs, but induced by the inflammatory stimuli (e.g. IFN-γ ± TNF- α, IL-1α or IL-1β) (MSC priming in vitro or at site of local tissue), and all contribute to tissue regeneration.
blocks.zh: MSC 可調控體液與細胞免疫，包括抑制 B、T、NK、樹突細胞，減少促發炎細胞激素，以及阻止嗜中性球募集（圖93.1）。它們可透過細胞接觸作用，但主要為旁分泌，釋放代謝酵素（Han 等，2022），核心為 IDO／iNOS，及 VEGF、PDGF、ANG-1、IL-11、PGE2、TSG-6、SDF-1、HGF、IGF-1 等因子。這些並非固定持續表現，而由 IFN-γ±TNF-α、IL-1α／β 等發炎刺激誘導，可在體外 priming 或局部組織發生，並共同促進修復。

blocks.en: Other MSC mechanism of actions, demonstrated on in vivo models, include: (a) mitochondrial transfer from MSC to T cells that was shown to trigger transcriptomic, metabolic, and functional reprogramming and favour Treg differentiation and (b) efferocytosis, the process by which apoptotic cells are engulfed, leading macrophages towards IDO expression and MSC towards PGE2 and IL-10 upregulation, which also accounts for their immunosuppressive activity (Galipeau and Sensebe 2018; Galleu et al. 2017; Pang et al. 2021; Zhang et al. 2019). MSC also produce extracellular vesicles (EVs), namely exosomes, microvesicles and apoptotic bodies, which are small membrane vesicles (44–100 nm diameter), with evident immunosuppressive and immunomodulatory activity in vitro and in animal models, for which clinical applications are currently under study in several AD.
blocks.zh: 體內模型還發現：a）MSC 將粒線體轉移給 T 細胞，可重整轉錄、代謝及功能，促進 Treg 分化；b）efferocytosis，即吞噬凋亡細胞的過程，促進巨噬細胞 IDO 表現，以及 MSC 的 PGE2、IL-10 上調，也參與免疫抑制作用（Galipeau 與 Sensebe，2018；Galleu 等，2017；Pang 等，2021；Zhang 等，2019）。MSC 亦產生 extracellular vesicles（EVs），包括 exosomes、microvesicles、apoptotic bodies；原文描述其為直徑 44–100 nm 的膜性囊泡，於體外及動物模型有明顯免疫調控／抑制活性，數種 AD 的臨床應用正在研究。

blocks.en: Fig. 93 .1 Immunomodulatory effects of mesenchymal stem cells (MSC) in autoimmune diseases. Proinflammatory microenvironment in autoimmune disease patients shift MSC towards an immunomodulatory state, able to target multiple cells from the innate (inhibition of dendritic [DC] and natural killer [NK] cells, and polarization of M1–M2 macrophages) and acquired (inhibition of B, T-CD4+ and T-CD8+ cells, and activation of regulatory T [Treg] cells) immune responses, notably through the production of metabolic enzymes (e.g.: Indeolemine 2,3 dioxygenase [IDO]) and cytokines (e.g.: transforming growth factor [TGF]- β, interleukins [IL]-6 and IL-10, prostaglandin E2 [PGE-2])
blocks.zh: 【圖93.1：MSC 在 AD 的免疫調控】病人的促發炎微環境，會使 MSC 轉向免疫調節狀態，同時影響先天免疫（抑制 DC、NK，促進巨噬細胞由 M1 向 M2 極化）與後天免疫（抑制 B、CD4+、CD8+ T 細胞，活化 Tregs）。主要媒介包括 IDO 等代謝酵素，以及 TGF-β、IL-6、IL-10、PGE2 等訊號分子。

blocks.en: The importance to assess MSC functional properties has been underlined since 2016 (Galipeau et al. 2016). The use of standardized functional markers of MSC potency and release potency assays, which must be defined to conduct advanced clinical studies, is of utmost importance and required to seek potential registration of the product. The preferred matrix assays to evaluate MSC immunosuppressive and immune-modulatory capacities include the use of: (a) quantitative RNA analysis of selected gene product, (b) flow cytometry analysis of function- ally relevant surface markers, and (c) proteinbased assay of secretome. In addition, multiparametric immune-monitoring tools have to be set up to characterize the patient immunological status and the various immune cell subsets before and after MSC treatment, to identify responders and thereby optimize clinical trials design.
blocks.zh: 自 2016 年起，MSC 功能評估的重要性受到強調（Galipeau 等，2016）。進階試驗及產品註冊，需定義標準化 potency 功能標記與產品放行試驗。建議矩陣式評估包括：a）特定基因產物的定量 RNA 分析；b）功能相關表面標記的流式分析；c）secretome 的蛋白質分析。此外，需建立多參數免疫監測，在治療前後描繪患者免疫狀態及各細胞亞群，辨認反應者並優化試驗設計。

blocks.en: 93.2.1 MSC Clinical Applications for AD MSCs produced from various sources [MSC(BM), MSC(UC)- and MSC(AT)] have been studied in around 1700 clinical trials worldwide for many conditions and their safety repeatedly demonstrated and summarized in a 2020 meta-analysis of 55 clinical trials in 12 countries using MSCs in 2700 recipients with various diseases (Thompson et al. 2020).
blocks.zh: 〔93.2.1 MSC 的 AD 臨床應用〕BM、UC、AT 等來源 MSC 已用於全球約 1,700 項、涵蓋多疾病的試驗；安全性反覆被證實。2020 年統合分析彙整 12 國 55 項試驗、2,700 名受者（Thompson 等，2020）。

blocks.en: Initially tested in the pre-clinical model of multiple sclerosis (MS), the rationale for using MSCs in AD was subsequently obtained in many preclinical models and provide effective experimental support for their clinical application in patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA), SLE and CD, which are characterized by a predominant auto-inflammatory component, but also in other AD, such as Sjogren disease, systemic sclerosis (SSc), type I and II diabetes or autism.
blocks.zh: MSC 的 AD 應用最初由 MS 前臨床模型支持，之後多種模型也提供證據，用於 RA、SLE、CD 等具顯著自體發炎成分的疾病，以及 Sjögren disease、SSc、第一／二型糖尿病或 autism 等其他情境。

blocks.en: Numerous phase I–II trials and few completed or still ongoing phase III trials worldwide were developed first in China and Asia, then in US and Europe, to analyse the safety and efficacy of either autologous or allogeneic MSCs, from various tissue sources (UC, B, AT) using single or repeated iv, sc or local injections in neurological, rheumatological or gastrointestinal AD.
blocks.zh: 世界各地有許多第一至二期，以及少數完成或進行中的第三期研究，先始於中國與亞洲，再擴至歐美。這些研究評估不同來源、自體或異體 MSC，以單次或重複靜脈、皮下或局部注射，治療神經、風濕及腸胃道 AD 的安全性與療效。

blocks.en: After 20 years of clinical research, since the first report (Le Blanc et al. 2004) on clinical efficacy of MSC(M) in a child with refractory aGvHD and more than 1360 clinical trials for MSC registered on Clinicaltrails.gov as of April 2023, in the field of AD per se only one MSC product allogeneic MSC(AT) for the treatment of Crohn’s fistula (Alofisel/Takeda) has been approved since 2018 in Europe, Japan and Canada. The first successful autologous MSC(AT) injection for CD rectovaginal fistula was performed in 2003. Several phase I and II studies for the treatment of anoperineal fistulas in CD reported 46–90%, efficacy until the ADMIRE phase III randomized, double-blind, international multicentre trial (RCT) demonstrated the superiority of MSC(AT) over placebo in 212 patients with CD and one or more complex anoperineal fistulas (Garcia-Olmo et al. 2022). For the other auto-immune diseases, several phase I–II studies reported safety results and promising efficacy signals in progressive MS, RA, SLE, SSc still require large RCT to demonstrate MSC efficacy (Burt et al. 2021; Farge et al. 2022; Loisel et al. 2023; Petrou et al. 2020; Wen et al. 2019).
blocks.zh: 自 Le Blanc 等（2004）首次報告 MSC 用於兒童難治 aGVHD 的臨床療效後，已有約二十年研究；截至 2023 年4月，ClinicalTrials.gov 登錄逾 1,360 項 MSC 試驗。但就 AD 本身，依原書時點，僅治療 Crohn fistula 的異體脂肪 MSC 產品 Alofisel／Takeda，自 2018 年起陸續在歐洲、日本、加拿大獲准。首例成功自體脂肪 MSC 注射治療 CD 直腸陰道瘻管是在 2003 年。多項第一、二期肛周瘻管研究的有效率為 46–90%；之後 ADMIRE 第三期國際多中心隨機雙盲試驗，在 212 名有複雜肛周瘻管的 CD 患者，證實脂肪 MSC 優於安慰劑（Garcia-Olmo 等，2022）。其他 AD 如進行型 MS、RA、SLE、SSc，有安全性及初步療效訊號，仍需大型 RCT 確認（Burt 等，2021；Farge 等，2022；Loisel 等，2023；Petrou 等，2020；Wen 等，2019）。
blocks.note: 產品核准、適應症與可得性依2024年版原書敘述保留，未視為2026年的現行藥證狀態。

blocks.en: Progress in the field has been hampered by large heterogeneity when considering each AD type and patient selection, MSC type, origin and production process, route of delivery and number of injections, clinical trial design and national regulations.
blocks.zh: 進展受到高度異質性限制，包括 AD 類型、病人選擇、MSC 種類／來源／製程、給藥途徑與次數、試驗設計及各國法規。

blocks.en: Although the number of clinical trials registered on www.clinicaltrials.gov using MSC-EVs for therapeutic purposes increases in the last 10 years, few results are available (Burt et al. 2021).
blocks.zh: 過去十年，MSC-EVs 的治療試驗登錄增加，但可用結果仍少（Burt 等，2021）。

blocks.en: 93.3 Regulatory T Cells (Tregs) Regulatory T cells (Tregs) are a specialized subset of CD4 + T lymphocytes endowed with immune-suppressive functions. Tregs are positively selected in the thymus and emigrate to the periphery. They represent a very heterogeneous population, distributed in secondary lymphoid organs and tissues. Tregs contribute to maintain the immune tolerance and to prevent autoimmunity. Tregs constitutionally express high levels of the interleukin-2 receptor alpha (CD25) and are highly enriched in the fraction of CD4+CD25bright cells. In addition, they are classically identified as CD127low and Forkhead-box-P3 (FoxP3) + cells.
blocks.zh: 〔93.3 調節性 T 細胞（Tregs）〕Tregs 是具免疫抑制功能的 CD4+ T 細胞亞群，經胸腺正向選擇後移至周邊，分布於次級淋巴器官及組織，異質性很高。它們維持免疫耐受並預防自體免疫，持續高表現 IL-2 receptor α（CD25），富集於 CD4+CD25bright 群體，典型表型另包括 CD127low、FoxP3+。

blocks.en: The FoxP3 transcription factor has been identified as the master regulator, which is essential for Treg development (Ikegawa and Matsuoka 2021).
blocks.zh: FoxP3 轉錄因子是 Treg 發育所必需的主調控因子（Ikegawa 與 Matsuoka，2021）。

blocks.en: Aberrant Treg plasticity, quantitative and functional deficiencies of Treg impair immune homeostasis and importantly contribute to AD (Selck and Dominguez-Villar 2021).
blocks.zh: Treg 可塑性異常、數量或功能不足，會破壞免疫恆定，促成 AD（Selck 與 Dominguez-Villar，2021）。

blocks.en: Considering their properties, Tregs represent the ideal candidate for immunotherapy in AD setting. To this end, several strategies ( Fig. 93.2) have been developed to enhance the Treg response (Doglio et al. 2022; Xue et al. 2022).
blocks.zh: 基於這些特性，Tregs 是 AD 免疫治療的理想候選。已有多種增強 Treg 反應的策略（圖93.2；Doglio 等，2022；Xue 等，2022）。

blocks.en: The first approach relies on the induction of Tregs directly in vivo, by enhancing their activity and/or persistence. Several drugs employed for the treatment of autoimmune diseases act directly or indirectly on Treg numbers and/or functionality. In this context, the role of rapamycin/sirolimus in increasing the number of Tregs through the inhibition of the mTOR pathway is well established (Greco et al. 2021; Peng et al. 2020).
blocks.zh: 第一種策略是在體內直接誘導 Tregs，提高活性或持續性。數種 AD 藥物可直接或間接影響 Treg 數量／功能；rapamycin／sirolimus 經 mTOR 抑制增加 Tregs 的作用已充分建立（Greco 等，2021；Peng 等，2020）。

blocks.en: Moreover, an indirect boost of Treg expansion may be induced by CY , as used after allogeneic haematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) for the prevention of GvHD (Cieri et al. 2015; Fletcher et al. 2023).
blocks.zh: CY 也可能間接促進 Treg 擴增，例如移植後用於 GVHD 預防時（Cieri 等，2015；Fletcher 等，2023）。

blocks.en: Other interventions that increase the number of polyclonal endogenous Treg cells in vivo involve low-dose interleukin-2 (IL-2), mutant IL-2, IL2/Anti-IL-2 Ab complexes. In contrast, applications of antigen-based treatments could lead to the enhancement of antigen-specific Treg subsets (Ikegawa and Matsuoka 2021).
blocks.zh: 其他在體內增加多克隆內生 Tregs 的方法，包括低劑量 IL-2、突變型 IL-2、IL-2／anti-IL-2 antibody complexes。相對地，抗原導向療法可增強抗原特異性 Treg 亞群（Ikegawa 與 Matsuoka，2021）。

blocks.en: Moreover, after autologous HCT, the reset of Treg compartment is essential to obtain long-term remission in ADs (Baraut et al. 2014; Cencioni et al. 2022; Doglio et al. 2022).
blocks.zh: Auto-HCT 後 Treg 群體的重置，也是 AD 達成長期緩解的關鍵（Baraut 等，2014；Cencioni 等，2022；Doglio 等，2022）。

blocks.en: A second approach relies on adoptive Treg cell therapies, through the optimal isolation and in vitro expansion of Treg cells.
blocks.zh: 第二種策略是過繼性 Treg 治療，透過最佳化分離及體外擴增取得細胞。

blocks.en: Data have shown the feasibility and safety of adoptive polyclonal Treg transfer, with variable efficacy, explained by the low level of Treg persistence in vivo and a limited number of Ag-specific cells in the final cell product (Doglio et al. 2022; Eggenhuizen et al. 2020). Challenges in in vitro Treg expansion and long-term persistence, as well as difficulties in the identification of specific antigens, have significantly slowed their clinical application (Xue et al. 2022).
blocks.zh: 多克隆 Treg 過繼輸注已證實可行且安全，但療效不一，可能因體內持續性低、最終產品的抗原特異性細胞比例有限（Doglio 等，2022；Eggenhuizen 等，2020）。體外擴增、長期存續與疾病特異抗原辨識的困難，都延緩臨床應用（Xue 等，2022）。

blocks.en: However, antigen-specific Tregs can be generated in vitro by genetic insertion of synthetic receptors, including engineered T cell receptors (TCR), B cell antibody receptors (BAR) or CAR (Scott 2021; Selck and Dominguez-Villar 2021).
blocks.zh: 但可經基因導入合成受體，在體外製造抗原特異性 Tregs；受體包括工程化 TCR、B-cell antibody receptor（BAR）或 CAR（Scott，2021；Selck 與 Dominguez-Villar，2021）。

blocks.en: In the context of autoimmunity, CARs may be effective in redirecting the antigen specificity of Tregs, boosting their suppressive capacities.
blocks.zh: 在自體免疫情境，CAR 可重新導向 Treg 的抗原特異性，增強其抑制能力。

blocks.en: CAR-Tregs proved very effective in controlling inflammatory conditions in pre-clinical studies (Doglio et al. 2022).
blocks.zh: CAR-Tregs 在前臨床研究，已非常有效地控制發炎狀態（Doglio 等，2022）。

blocks.en: ac b d Fig. 93.2 Regulatory T cells (Treg)-based approaches in autoimmune diseases (AD). Polyclonal and antigenspecific Treg cell-based therapies are the 2 main strategies: the administration of immunomodulatory agents that enhance the number and/or function of Treg cells in vivo (a, b), and the adoptive transfer of in vitro expanded Treg cells (c, d). Interventions that increase polyclonal endogenous Treg cells in vivo involve drugs (ie sirolimus), low-dose interleukin-2 (IL-2), mutant IL-2, IL2/Anti-IL-2 Ab complexes as well as selective depletion of effector T (Teff) cells by Anti-CD3 Ab (a). Applications of antigenbased treatments could lead to the enhancement of antigen- specific Treg subsets (b). Adoptive Treg cell therapies rely on the optimal isolation and expansion of Treg cells in vitro. One option is based on expanded polyclonal Treg cell populations (c). Moreover, antigen-specific Treg cells can be generated in vitro ( d) by genetic insertion of synthetic receptors (engineered T cell receptors [TCR], chimeric antigen receptors [CAR] or B cell antibody receptors [BAR]) or by transformation of antigen-specific Teff cells into induced Treg (iTreg) cells via stimulation in the presence of transforming growth factor beta (TGF- β) and IL-2, transgenic FOXP3 overexpression, blockade of cyclin-dependent kinase 8 (CDK8) and CDK19 signaling, or a combination of cytotoxic T lymphocyte antigen 4 (CTLA-4) overexpression, IL-2 ablation and antigenic stimulation. (Doglio et al. 2022; Selck and Dominguez-Villar 2021)]
blocks.zh: 【圖93.2：Treg 為基礎的 AD 治療】主要有體內增強 Treg 與過繼輸注體外擴增 Treg 兩大策略，均可為多克隆或抗原特異性。a）增加體內多克隆 Treg：sirolimus 等藥物、低劑量 IL-2、突變型 IL-2、IL-2／anti-IL-2 複合物，以及 anti-CD3 選擇性去除 effector T（Teff）細胞。b）抗原療法增強抗原特異性亞群。c）最佳化分離與擴增後，回輸多克隆 Tregs。d）體外製造抗原特異性 Tregs：導入工程化 TCR、CAR、BAR，或將抗原特異性 Teff 轉為 induced Tregs（iTregs）。轉換方法包括 TGF-β＋IL-2 刺激、轉基因 FOXP3 過度表現、阻斷 CDK8／CDK19，或合併 CTLA-4 過度表現、IL-2 去除及抗原刺激。Ag＝抗原；DCs＝樹突細胞；APL＝改變的 peptide ligands；pMHC＝peptide–MHC 複合體。改編自 Doglio 等（2022）、Selck 與 Dominguez-Villar（2021）。

blocks.en: 93.4 Chimeric Antigen Receptor T Cells (CART) Chimeric antigen receptors (CAR) are chimeric molecules capable of redirecting the specificity of engineered cells against target antigens, while simultaneously boosting their activation (Freitag et al. 2020).
blocks.zh: 〔93.4 CAR-T〕CAR 是嵌合分子，能把工程化細胞的特異性重新導向目標抗原，同時增強細胞活化（Freitag 等，2020）。

blocks.en: CARs are composed of three major components: an extracellular domain, a linker peptide and an intracellular part. The extracellular domain accounts for the recognition of the anti-gen. The intracellular portion mediates the transduction of the signal upon antigen binding.
blocks.zh: 其三個主要部分為胞外區、連接 peptide、胞內區；胞外區負責辨識抗原，胞內區在結合抗原後傳遞訊號。

blocks.en: The most frequently used intracellular portions are represented by the zeta-chain of CD3 (CD3z) and the intracellular portion of CD28, 4-1BB and OX-40, each molecule being involved in the co- stimulation and activation of T lymphocytes (Doglio et al. 2022). According to the composition of the intracellular part, different generations of CARs can be distinguished: (a) the first generation composed only by the CD3z, (b) the second generation with two different domains with CD28-CD3z and 4-1BB-CD3z, which represent the two most frequent combinations in use and (c) a third generation with three domains, generally obtained by adding OX-40 to a second generation CAR (Sadelain et al. 2017).
blocks.zh: 最常見胞內構造包括 CD3ζ，以及 CD28、4-1BB、OX-40 的胞內區，參與 T 細胞共刺激與活化（Doglio 等，2022）。依組成可區分：第一代僅 CD3ζ；第二代含兩個區域，最常見為 CD28–CD3ζ 或 4-1BB–CD3ζ；第三代有三個區域，通常在第二代上再加 OX-40（Sadelain 等，2017）。

blocks.en: Conventional T cells (Tconvs) expressing CARs revealed impressive clinical results in patients affected by haematological malignancies, since their cytotoxic action could be specifically redirected against transformed cells (Sterner and Sterner 2021).
blocks.zh: 表現 CAR 的 conventional T cells（Tconvs），能將細胞毒性導向轉化細胞，在血液惡性疾病取得顯著結果（Sterner 與 Sterner，2021）。

blocks.en: Additionally, CAR-T cells (CART) may be employed in the field of autoimmunity, thanks to their ability of conferring new antigenspecificities and to simultaneously boost cell activation (Alexander and Greco 2022).
blocks.zh: 因為 CAR 能同時賦予新抗原特異性並增強活化，也可應用於自體免疫（Alexander 與 Greco，2022）。

blocks.en: B cells and their effectors such as antibodies and cytokines impact the pathophysiology of ADs (Lee et al. 2021), thus attracting innovative B cell depletion therapies. Compared to monoclonal antibodies, CART have the advantage of a broader depletion of autoreactive B cells, (Doglio et al. 2022), especially those maintained in inflamed tissues and access to lymphoid organ (i.e. lymph node and spleen).
blocks.zh: B 細胞及其抗體、細胞激素等效應產物參與 AD 病理，因此引發新 B 細胞去除療法的興趣（Lee 等，2021）。相較單株抗體，CAR-T 可更廣泛清除自體反應性 B 細胞，尤其是發炎組織中殘留者，並能進入淋巴結、脾臟（Doglio 等，2022）。

blocks.en: Recent clinical experiences ( Table 93.1) suggest the efficacy of CD19-CAR Tconvs in SLE, showing resolution of nephritis and other diseaserelated symptoms in five patients (Mackensen et al. 2022; Mougiakakos et al. 2021). This effect is associated with a profound B-cell depletion, followed by B-cell repopulation over time, after a median observation of 110 days post-infusion.
blocks.zh: 早期臨床經驗（表93.1）顯示，CD19-CAR Tconvs 對 SLE 有效，五名患者的腎炎及其他症狀消退（Mackensen 等，2022；Mougiakakos 等，2021）。此效果伴隨深度 B 細胞去除，之後在輸注後中位約 110 天觀察到 B 細胞重新出現。

blocks.en: After 3 months, circulating CARTs were still detectable. All patients received autologous CD19directed CART, without developing relevant toxicities, and only mild cytokine-release syndrome was reported in these patients. All patients had a normalization of serum double- stranded DNA antibodies and complement levels.
blocks.zh: 三個月後，循環中仍可檢出 CAR-T。所有人均接受自體 CD19 CAR-T，沒有重大毒性，僅輕度 CRS；anti-dsDNA 抗體與補體數值皆恢復正常。

blocks.en: Other preliminary experiences with CD19targeted CART have been reported in a case of refractory antisynthetase syndrome (Muller et al. 2023) and a patient with severe SSc (Bergmann et al. 2023).
blocks.zh: CD19 CAR-T 另有難治 antisynthetase syndrome 一例（Müller 等，2023）及嚴重 SSc 一例的初步經驗（Bergmann 等，2023）。

blocks.en: CART therapy that targets B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA) has been explored in 12 patients with relapsed/refractory neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) (Qin et al. 2023).
blocks.zh: BCMA CAR-T 已在 12 名 R/R neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder（NMOSD）患者研究（Qin 等，2023）。

blocks.en: Only a mild cytokine release syndrome was reported. No relapse has been observed at a median follow-up of 5.5 months in 11 patients, paralleled by a reduction of autoantibodies.
blocks.zh: 只報告輕度 CRS；中位追蹤 5.5 個月時，11 名患者未復發，並伴隨自體抗體下降。

blocks.en: Overall, initial experiences suggest a rapid response of AD to CART therapy, although extended follow-up is needed to determine long-term efficacy.
blocks.zh: 整體初步經驗顯示 AD 對 CAR-T 可迅速反應，但需延長追蹤確定長期療效。

blocks.en: 93.5 Conclusions and Future Directions New insights are emerging in the complexity and power of innovative cellular therapies. MSC, a heterogeneous population of stromal cells with high regenerative capacity that can be isolated, cultured, and expanded ex vivo represent a promising source for cellular therapy approaches in AD due to their immunosuppressive, angiogenic and anti-fibrotic properties. MSCs plasticity and their regenerative and immunomodulatory properties are known to be driven by microenvironmental factors. MSC of different tissue origin have been investigated for treating several indications. Progresses in the field have been hampered by large heterogeneity of MSC products and sources. Promising results have been obtained in SSc, SLE and access to the market in CD.
blocks.zh: 〔93.5 結論與未來方向〕創新細胞治療的複雜性與潛力，正逐漸被了解。MSC 是可分離、培養與體外擴增、具高再生能力的異質 stromal cells，免疫抑制、促血管新生及抗纖維化特性，使其成為 AD 有希望的細胞來源。其可塑性、再生與免疫調節能力受微環境驅動，不同組織來源已用於多種疾病，但產品與來源異質性阻礙進展。SSc、SLE 有鼓舞結果，CD 已有產品上市。

blocks.en: Tregs, a specialized subset of T lymphocytes with immune suppressive capacities and dysfunctional in AD constitute the ideal candidate for adoptive cell therapy in AD. Despite safe, polyclonal Tregs mediated suboptimal/controversial responses in clinical trials, mainly due to low amount of disease relevant antigen-specific cells.
blocks.zh: Tregs 具有免疫抑制能力，AD 中常功能失調，是過繼治療理想候選。多克隆 Treg 雖安全，臨床反應仍不理想或有爭議，主因可能是疾病相關抗原特異性細胞太少。

blocks.en: CARs can redirect the T cell antigen specificity, aiming at restoring the immune tolerance.
blocks.zh: CAR 可重新導向 T 細胞抗原特異性，以恢復免疫耐受為目標。

blocks.en: CAR-Tregs were proven very effective in controlling inflammatory conditions in AD pre-clinical studies Current available clinical data reveal that CD19 conventional CART effectively deplete B cells in patients with SLE, leading to impressive drug-free remission in patients refractory to standard therapies. The clinical effect of CART appears to be associated with abrogation of autoimmunity and persists even after B cell reconstitution. Longer follow-up is warranted after these preliminary promising experiences with various CART approaches in a variety of AD (antisynthetase syndrome, SSc, NMOSD).
blocks.zh: CAR-Tregs 在 AD 前臨床研究有效控制發炎。現有早期臨床資料顯示，CD19 conventional CAR-T 能有效清除 SLE 的 B 細胞，讓標準治療難治者出現顯著無藥物緩解；效果似與自體免疫消退相關，即使 B 細胞恢復後仍持續。Antisynthetase syndrome、SSc、NMOSD 的不同 CAR-T 初步經驗，仍需更長追蹤。

blocks.en: These findings show that the generation and administration of CART in AD is feasible and safe.
blocks.zh: 這些發現顯示，在 AD 製造及給予 CAR-T 是可行且初步安全的。

blocks.en: Future studies are warranted to further elucidate the mechanism of action of these cellularbased therapies, while shedding light on the underlying pathogenesis of AD.
blocks.zh: 未來研究需進一步闡明細胞療法機轉，也藉此了解 AD 本身的病理。

blocks.en: Key Points • AD are heterogeneous conditions characterized by aberrant activation of the immune system with failure of the immune regulation to maintain adapted tolerance.
blocks.zh: 【章末重點】① AD 是免疫異常活化、調控無法維持耐受的異質疾病。

blocks.en: • The optimal treatment of AD should be discussed, in light of this pathological continuum between autoimmunity and auto-inflammation, which variably interacts in each AD phenotypic expression.
blocks.zh: ② 最佳治療應考慮自體免疫與自體發炎的連續光譜，以及兩者對各疾病表型的不同影響。

blocks.en: • MSC based therapies appear as ideal tools to target the respective autoinflammatory and autoimmune components of AD. Progresses in the field have been hampered by large heterogeneity.
blocks.zh: ③ MSC 理論上可同時針對兩種病理成分，但高度異質性阻礙進展。

blocks.en: • Tregs constitute the ideal candidate for adoptive cell therapy in AD, aiming at restoring the immune tolerance. Despite safe, polyclonal Tregs mediated controversial results in clinical trials. CAR- Tregs proved very effective in controlling inflammatory conditions in pre-clinical studies.
blocks.zh: ④ Tregs 可望恢復耐受；多克隆產品雖安全，試驗療效有爭議。CAR-Tregs 前臨床抑制發炎效果良好。

blocks.en: • CART approach is feasible, tolerable and highly effective in severe/refractory SLE and other AD (antisynthetase syndrome, SSc, NMOSD) in preliminary clinical reports. Longer follow-up is warranted.
blocks.zh: ⑤ 初步報告中，CAR-T 對嚴重／難治 SLE，以及 antisynthetase syndrome、SSc、NMOSD 可行、耐受且有效，仍需長期追蹤。
